notes:
Inbound SMB lead from self-serve sign-up. Product manager (Maya R.) reached out via contact form asking for guidance on model choices for an in-app support assistant. Key emphasis: cost per active user and predictable latency on hosted plans.

Summary of ask:
- Wants to start on Hosted API, self-serve, up to 2k monthly active users initially.
- Primary workloads: short multi-turn chat (support agent), ticket summarization, embeddings for search/reranking.
- Model questions centered on: Llama vs Mistral vs Qwen family — tradeoffs of quality vs unit cost; impact of 4-bit/8-bit quantization on quality; latency expectations on Redwood hosted.

On the discovery call (2026-03-04):
- "We need something like Llama 2 quality but cheaper — is Mistral a good compromise?" — Maya.
- They are cost-sensitive: target ~ $0.50-$1.50 per MAU/month for core chat workload initially; want per-token cost estimates to justify choice.
- Latency target: 95th percentile reply time under 600ms for short messages (<=200 tokens). Happy to trade slight quality for big cost savings if hallucination risk is low.
- Interested in quantized models (4-bit) if Redwood hosted supports them and latency doesn't degrade. Asked about memory limits for browser-based clients vs server-side calls.

Notes from SE (Priya):
- Recommended path: start with Mistral-7B / Qwen-7B variants on hosted to benchmark cost/latency; escalate to Llama-2-13B or Llama-2-70B family only if quality delta requires it. Consider Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and prefix caching to reduce per-token costs.
- Ask submitted: benchmark suite with their 50 test prompts + 3 representative chat flows. Priya to run compare (token cost, latency p50/p95, top-level answer-quality rubric).

Operational / security:
- SMB, but wants SOC2 and SSO readiness later. No air-gapped/on-prem requirement for now.
- Retention: default retention fine for self-serve; legal requested DPA template and retention controls doc.

Stubs/links:
- Drive: Redwood quickstart + pricing deck link above.
- Fireflies: ff_2026-03-04_01 meeting transcript (call notes attached).
- Jira: INFR-3421 opened to validate hosted quantized model availability and rate-limit guidance.

Tone and misc: short, pragmatic. Prospect comfortable with iterative approach: "Start small, prove cost, then expand." Wants clear numbers to show to CFO.

Recommended next messages to prospect:
1) Send matrix comparing Mistral-7B / Qwen-7B / Llama-2-13B: expected per-token cost (hosted), estimated p50/p95 latency on Redwood hosted small plan, quality note (expected gap), suggestion on quantization (4-bit vs 8-bit) and risk tolerance.
2) Attach request for 50 sample prompts and permission to run a short 1-hour benchmark.
3) Attach DPA + SOC2 summary + short doc on retention controls.
